title: "Run in Place" by Selca, IamEmphatic, and Real U-Neek is all we need
htmlContent:
Next rated artist, Selca is a multi-talented singer and songwriter who has countlessly proven to her fans how talented she is, especially with the release of her recent song, "Run In Place (feat. IamEmphatic and Real U-Neek)."

Selca combines IamEmphatic and Real U-Neek to make a must-hear love song, "Run In Place." Now more than ever, Selca brings an ultra-smooth sound filled with flavor to the new song "Run In Place." Everything about this record screams appeal, with a stand-out sound digestible in every way to make something for the people to enjoy.
